fixed: Predictions, original model settings and canopy scale choices
loss_units: Brier/logloss original units; delta is augmented minus base; relative_brier_change_pct is percent of base Brier. Displayed Brier deltas and intervals are multiplied by1000.
interval_scope: low/high are95% paired fixed-prediction Brier intervals, not logloss intervals or development-refit uncertainty.
interpretation: All four intervals span zero. A zero-spanning interval does not establish equivalent performance. These retrospective prediction comparisons do not measure vegetation-management effects.
separate_context: target_canopy_context.csv covers13km target means at2015,2020,2025 without interpolation; it is not the canopy predictor used in these four comparisons.
